visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a white shirt, a brown bracelet, and a belt, waves at the camera while sitting in a business class airplane cabin seat. She holds up a lime green pouch with the brand name "Bamford" embossed on the front. The lighting is bright and warm, illuminating the cabin background. (2) She opens the green pouch and pulls out several travel items sequentially, including a grey eye mask, a pair of 3M earplugs in tan packaging, and a white toothbrush kit. She holds each item close to the lens for inspection. Text overlays identifying the items appear at the bottom. (3) She presents a small green tube of cooling body gel and expresses surprise with wide eyes. She squeezes some clear gel onto her wrist and rubs it in with her hands. Variety text with red question marks appears briefly. (4) She displays a white bottle of "Waken" mouthwash and a small tube of multipurpose balm. She points to her lips while holding the balm. The camera remains at a steady medium close-up shot size. (5) She removes a small spray bottle of pillow mist and holds up a large white pillow from her seat. She sprays the mist onto the pillow and sniffs it, looking contemplative. A laughing emoji and thumbs-up icon are overlaid. (6) She returns the items to the pouch and holds the green kit up one final time, waving goodbye with a bright smile before the video ends. The background remains the interior of the airplane cabin throughout.
